audit_kind: Unconditional published-input infinite actual long-base-2 obstruction for shared near-linear scattered original-column menus selected from m and N mod m. Native kernel credit is twelve finite arithmetic lemmas; the infinite counting proof is classical.
goal_turn_classification_scope: Arithmetic all-hit acquisition failure on infinite actual inputs for a specified near-linear menu route, including one residue digit; no examples or backend-only lemmas counted as the substantive advance.
user_frontier: Whole-family Otilde(m) acquisition or a rigorous arithmetic obstruction for a precisely specified proposed acquisition route.
source_snapshot_scope: All 443 parent selected source pins and all 78 parent selected Mathlib pins revalidated and retained. Adds parent audit, new leaf and checker. Mutable root/metadata/journal separately tracked by exact insertion against fresh current snapshots. No full historical closure rebuild claimed.

published_input.source: Kurlberg and Pomerance, Acta Arithmetica 119.2 (2005), Section 4, Lemma 19; explicit Baker--Harman (7.1) formulation

exact_integer_fiber_bridge.offset_periodicity: delta_j(p*q)=delta_j(p*q0) as integers when q=q0 mod m^2 and j coprime m.
exact_integer_fiber_bridge.whole_original_family_cardinality: At most 4m exact (j,q) incidences at arbitrary fixed row targets, for m prime and p mod m neither zero nor one.
exact_integer_fiber_bridge.fixed_nonzero_q_class_row_cardinality: At most two row labels, from (qbar-T)*j^2-2*s*j+s=0 modulo m.
exact_integer_fiber_bridge.fixed_class_false_tag_fiber_cardinality: At most one exact integer cofactor per false residue tag, hence at most TWO false (j,q) incidences altogether.

unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.family: Original denominator-one seedRow family j=1,...,m-1; shared columns r in [0,seedLength(m)).
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.menu_size: For every fixed C,A, uniformly |C_(m,s)|<=C*m*(log m)^A.
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.quantifier: For EACH fixed menu family satisfying the uniform cap, there exist infinitely many actual failing N; the failing family may depend on the menu family.
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.actual_balance: Winning fixed finite ratio box gives p<q<=3p/2; m^2<=p,q and 2p,2q<=3m^3 eventually.
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.parameters: M=X^(1/3), V=O(X^(1-kappa)), m comparable to M, p-1=v*R_p, v<=V=o(m), R_p≫m^2.
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.whole_small_prefix: For fixed C_* all r<=C_*m can be absent; total bad pairs O(V*M^5).
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.large_column_multiplier_range: K<0 and |K| comparable to v*r/m for r>C_*m.
unconditional_scattered_menu_obstruction.full_original_scalar_on_balanced_counter: Saturated: zero modulo N; separate forced field collisions still exist at unselected indices.

m_only_accessible_envelope_corollary.full_N_adaptive_controller_scope: Covered only if every accessible column is in one fixed m-only envelope of total Otilde(m) size.

two_digit_menu_true_tag_obstruction.menu_input: (m,n), n=N mod m^2; uniform Otilde(m) shared menu.
two_digit_menu_true_tag_obstruction.coefficients: Literal original a_j and centered b_j fixed by (m,n,j).
two_digit_menu_true_tag_obstruction.unique_true_tag_hit: Original forced r_* lies below L; R_p≫L makes every true-tag local hit r<L equal r_*.
two_digit_menu_true_tag_obstruction.necessary_exact_cofactor: q=m^2*r-ell_j-a_j*p, p=j mod m, p=1 mod v.
two_digit_menu_true_tag_obstruction.row_harmonic_sum: a_j=n*j^(-2) mod m has at most two j per nonzero a; sum_j 1/a_j=O(log m).

two_digit_second_repeated_branch_obstruc.first_branch: Integer K=-v*a_j; literal forced index, already counted.
two_digit_second_repeated_branch_obstruc.carry_permutation: For fixed a_j,j, the m second-digit carries n sweep b_j mod m bijectively, and hence all lifts of one nonzero K class mod m.
two_digit_second_repeated_branch_obstruc.global_count: O(V*M^5)=O(X^(8/3-kappa)), all columns below L at once.
two_digit_second_repeated_branch_obstruc.remaining_two_digit_case: FALSE SIMPLE roots only; no power-saving count supplied here.

no_global_common_original_root_corollary.native_literal_index: m^2*r=p+q-1+delta_j for ANY original global common hit, including false tags.

classical_selected_column_cost_scope.construction: U(T)=product_j(T-x_j), monic product/remainder tree evaluated at selected alpha^r.
classical_selected_column_cost_scope.bit_time_and_peak_space: Otilde(m*log N) for Otilde(m) selected columns, with fast packed polynomial arithmetic.
classical_selected_column_cost_scope.division: Monic divisors; reversed divisor constant one; Newton H -> H*(2-G*H), no unknown-unit or inverse-of-two requirement.
classical_selected_column_cost_scope.packing_digit_width: 2W+ceil(log_2 d)+1 for degree d and W-bit modulus, preventing convolution carries.
classical_selected_column_cost_scope.reference_scope: Introduction documents standard quasi-linear commutative-ring polynomial operations. Its Las Vegas field modular composition theorem is not used as whole-family acquisition.
classical_selected_column_cost_scope.nested_partial_norm_route_remaining: O(log m) nested partial norms and one final marked row suffice; direct transposed evaluator remains Otilde(m^(3/2)).

limitations: The infinite actual-input proofs rely on published unformalized density and classical counts; only twelve finite arithmetic lemmas are newly kernel checked.
The all-hit obstruction concerns shared menu families using m and N mod m, or a fixed m-only accessible envelope. Arbitrary full-N menus remain open.
For full N mod m^2 menus, true tags and second repeated branches are controlled, but false simple roots remain open; no general unit/gcd-one conclusion is made.
No universal lower bound for general factoring, tagged jets, partial norms or arbitrary implicit circuits is claimed.
The selected-column fast bit arithmetic and a near-linear nested partial-norm evaluator are not newly implemented or Lean-priced.
next_required_advance: Resolve false simple-hit coverage or obstruction for full N mod m^2 scattered menus; prove a full-N adaptive near-linear acquisition route; or obtain total Otilde(m) nested partial norms and one marked row. Then finish physical fast bit backends, routing/controller, nonunit/saturation recovery, prime squares and total bit complexity.
